components.title: Site ingress
components.description: The HAProxy Kubernetes Ingress controller in front of the site services.

control-implementations.description: What the site stack's rendered manifests show about the ingress controller.

implemented-requirements.description: The site stack renders no ingress-nginx controller.

statements.description: Every release of the site stack, rendered offline from the hash-checked vendored charts with the CI site file, contains no ingress-nginx reference, no nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io annotation and no nginx ingress class; the render test fails on any match.
statements.remarks: Your organization runs the ingress controller the site stack installs and adds no ingress-nginx controller to the cluster.
